blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Даже нудисты часто используют эвфемизмы, говоря о ___ (срамное место, prep. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Even nudists often use euphemisms when referring to naughty parts.
exercises.why: **место → местах** (prep. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural места. Declines like DLI's окно — every plural form has the same endings (P. pl. окнах). Ending -о → -ах.  **срамной → срамных** (prep. pl., agreeing with местах). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): P. новых. Ending -ые → -ых.  Declension: sg. место · места · месту · место · местом · месте; pl. места · мест · местам · места · местами · местах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не суди о ___ (книга, prep. sg.) по обложке.
exercises.prompt: Don't judge a book by its cover.
exercises.why: **книга → книге** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. газете). Ending -а → -е.  Declension: sg. книга · книги · книге · книгу · книгой · книге; pl. книги · книг · книгам · книги · книгами · книгах.  «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. … The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.» — DLI, Lessons 16–17.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они умалчивали о ___ (свой план, prep. pl.).
exercises.prompt: They kept silent about their plans.
exercises.why: **план → планах** (prep. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural планы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (P. pl. столах). Ending — (no ending) → -ах.  **свой → своих** (prep. pl., agreeing with планах). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -и → -их.  Declension: sg. план · плана · плану · план · планом · плане; pl. планы · планов · планам · планы · планами · планах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Ending -ые → -ых.  Declension: sg. эффект · эффекта · эффекту · эффект · эффектом · эффекте; pl. эффекты · эффектов · эффектам · эффекты · эффектами · эффектах.  «For the dative and the prepositional plural there are two kinds of endings for each case: -ам, -ами, -ах after a hard, a sibilant or a guttural consonant; -ям, -ями, -ях after a soft consonant, a «ь» or a vowel. The formation of these cases does not depend upon the gender of the noun, but only upon the sound preceding the ending.» — DLI, Lessons 42–45.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Эта книга не о ___ (языкознание, prep. sg.).
exercises.prompt: This book is not about linguistics.
exercises.why: **языкознание → языкознании** (prep. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. здании). Ending -е → -и. exercises.q: Что ты думаешь об ___ (эта экипировка, prep. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: What do you think about this outfit?
exercises.why: **экипировка → экипировке** (prep. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (P. sg. газете). Its forms (f. sg.): эта · этой · этой · эту · этой · этой. exercises.q: Он бледнеет от одной мысли о ___ (змея, prep. pl.).
exercises.prompt: The very thought of snakes makes him turn pale.
exercises.why: **змея → змеях** (prep. pl.). Feminine, animate; nominative plural змеи.
